sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: Elementary House reimagines the archetype of the holiday cabin as a contemporary home where architecture is shaped by everyday rituals, creativity, and a deep connection to nature. Designed by YUMI Architekci, the house is located in a quiet, green setting on the outskirts of Warsaw. Surrounded by a garden and mature vegetation, the site offered an opportunity to create a retreat from the pace of the city while maintaining the comfort of year-round living.
